info.name: BetMate API
info.description: Run requests top to bottom in order. Two accounts are used: Challenger (sends bets) and Challengee (receives bets). Tokens and IDs are captured automatically — you never need to copy-paste anything.

graphql.query: query { health }

item.name: 1. Setup Accounts
item.description: Run both requests in order. Challenger = the user who sends challenges. Challengee = the user who receives them. All tokens are saved automatically.

request.description: Creates the account that will send friend requests and bet challenges. Saves challengerToken and challengerId automatically.
Creates the account that receives friend requests and bet challenges. Saves challengeeToken and challengeeId automatically.

item.name: 2. Become Betmates
item.description: Challenger sends a friend request. Challengee accepts it. After this they can challenge each other on matches.

request.description: Runs as Challenger. Saves friendshipId automatically.
Runs as Challengee. Uses the friendshipId saved in the previous step.
Verify the Challengee appears in Challenger's betmates list.
Search for users by username or name. Blocked users are hidden. Returns friendship status alongside each result.

item.name: Cricket Sync
item.description: Verify the mock cricket scheduler is working. The scheduler runs automatically on server startup (no action needed). These requests just read what it created. Expected: 2 UPCOMING, 1 LIVE, 2 COMPLETED, 1 CANCELLED.

request.description: Returns all matches across all statuses. Run this right after server start to confirm the mock scheduler synced all 6 scenarios.

exec: matches.forEach(m => console.log(' ', m.status, '|', m.team1, 'vs', m.team2, '| winner:', m.winnerTeam || '-'));

request.description: Should return 2 upcoming matches: Mumbai Indians vs Chennai Super Kings (~5h from now) and Royal Challengers Bengaluru vs Kolkata Knight Riders (~26h from now).
Should return 1 live match: Sunrisers Hyderabad vs Rajasthan Royals (started 1 hour ago).
Should return 2 completed matches: Gujarat Titans vs Lucknow Super Giants (GT won) and Delhi Capitals vs Punjab Kings (PBKS won). The sync service resolved these automatically.

exec: json.data.matches.forEach(m => console.log('COMPLETED:', m.team1, 'vs', m.team2, '| winner:', m.winnerTeam));

item.name: 3. Get a Match
item.description: The mock scheduler auto-creates upcoming matches on server startup. Run '1. Get Upcoming Matches' to pick a match for the bet flow — matchId, team1, and team2 are saved automatically.

request.description: Saves matchId, team1, and team2 from the first result. These are used in all bet requests.

item.name: 4. Bet Flow
item.description: The complete bet lifecycle from challenge to team lock. Run every request in this folder top to bottom without skipping any.

request.description: Challenger sends a bet challenge to Challengee on the saved match. Saves betId automatically.
Challengee checks their inbox. Should see the PENDING challenge from Challenger.
Challengee accepts. Status moves to ACCEPTED. Either user can now flip the coin.

exec: console.log('Challenge accepted! Either user can now flip the coin.');

request.description: Random 50/50 toss. Saves tossWinnerId and tossWinnerToken automatically. The next request uses the winner's token with no manual steps.

exec: console.log('Pick Team will automatically run as the winner.');

request.description: Runs automatically as the toss winner. Picks team1. The other team is automatically assigned to the opponent. Status moves to TEAMS_LOCKED.
Shows you and all your Betmates ranked by total points. Both accounts will show 0 points here (no completed bets yet). Points update in section 5.

exec: console.log('#' + e.rank, e.user.username, e.points + 'pts', e.betsWon + 'W', e.betsLost + 'L');

request.description: Full history between Challenger and Challengee. myWins and theirWins only count COMPLETED bets so they will show 0 until section 5 is run.

exec: console.log('vs', h.betmate.username, '| You:', h.myWins, 'W | Them:', h.theirWins, 'W | Net:', h.netPoints, 'pts');

item.name: 5. Resolve and Check Results
item.description: Simulate match completion and verify points are awarded. Run after completing section 4. The Resolve Match request only works in local dev.

request.description: Declares team1 as the match winner. TEAMS_LOCKED bets are settled: team1 picker gets +10, other gets -10. Change winnerTeam to {{team2}} to flip the result. Only works in local dev.

exec: console.log('Settled:', result.settled, '| Cancelled:', result.cancelled, '| Expired:', result.expired);

request.description: Verify the bet moved to COMPLETED and the winner field is set.
Should now show +10 and -10 instead of 0 0.

exec: console.log('#' + e.rank, e.user.username, e.points + 'pts', e.betsWon + 'W', e.betsLost + 'L');

request.description: myWins and theirWins should now show the result of the completed bet.

exec: pm.test("Win count is recorded", () => pm.expect(h.myWins + h.theirWins).to.be.above(0));
console.log('vs', h.betmate.username, '| You:', h.myWins, 'W | Them:', h.theirWins, 'W | Net:', h.netPoints, 'pts');

item.name: 6. Error Cases
item.description: These verify the API rejects invalid actions. Each request expects a GraphQL error. Tests go green when an error IS returned.

request.description: Run Send Challenge first, then immediately run this without running Accept Challenge. Should return INVALID_STATUS.

header.description: Change to challengeeToken if Challenger won the toss

request.description: After flipping the coin, run this as the toss loser before T-2h. Should return NOT_TOSS_WINNER.
Tries to challenge a user who is not a Betmate. Should return NOT_BETMATES.

graphql.query: query MyBets { myBets { id } }

request.description: No Authorization header. Should return UNAUTHENTICATED.
Use this INSTEAD of Accept Challenge to test the decline flow. Run Send Challenge first to get a fresh PENDING bet.

item.name: 7. Profile & Account
item.description: Profile update, password change, and blocked users list. All run as Challenger by default.

request.description: Update firstName, lastName, or username. All fields are optional — only provided fields are changed.
Changes the password for the current user. Invalidates all existing refresh tokens (forces re-login on other devices). Wrong current password returns INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

exec: console.log('Password changed. Re-login required on other devices.');

request.description: Lists all users blocked by the current user. Only shows users YOU blocked — not users who blocked you.

Challenger withdraws a PENDING challenge before the challengee responds. Run Send Challenge first to get a PENDING bet, then run this instead of Accept/Decline. Only the challenger can cancel — challengee gets FORBIDDEN.

item.name: Dev Utilities
item.description: Local dev only — blocked in production. Use these when you need fresh match data after the scheduler-created matches are already resolved.

request.description: Creates a fresh UPCOMING match. Use this after the scheduler-created mock matches are all resolved and you want to run the bet flow again without resetting the DB. Saves matchId, team1, team2 automatically.

exec: console.log('Match', action + ':', match.team1, 'vs', match.team2, '| id:', match.id);

item.name: Auth Utilities
item.description: Standalone auth operations. Not part of the main test flow — use these if tokens expire.

graphql.query:
query Me {
  me {
    id
    email
    username
    firstName
    lastName
    points
    emailVerified
    isActive
    lastLogin
    createdAt
  }
}

request.description: Use this if your challengerToken expired. Replace the email with the Challenger's email from signup.
Use this if your challengeeToken expired. Replace the email with the Challengee's email from signup.
